rows.label: qst610101_msg0002
rows.name:
I work at the Nokirua Logging
Site up by the Gula Divine Beast's
nape, you see.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0003
rows.name: We cut down trees almost every day...

rows.label: qst610101_msg0004
rows.name:
Recently, several dozen trees we'd cut
down went missing.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0005
rows.name:
Cutting the trees is hard, and since
they're heavy, hauling them is hard
too.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0006
rows.name:
Even working together, we manage about
five a day.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0007
rows.name:
Stealing dozens of them like that...
It's disheartening.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0009
rows.name:
Oh man, everyone at the site will
be so thrilled to hear that.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0010
rows.name:
Afraid I got nothing when it
comes to the thief, though.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0011
rows.name:
First, ask everyone at the Nokirua
Logging Site what they know.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0012
rows.name:
I'll head over there later to
hear what you've found out.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0101
rows.name:
I want you to find whoever's stealing
wood from the timber site.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0102
rows.name:
First, talk to everyone at the
Nokirua Logging Site up by the Gula
Divine Beast's nape.

rows.label: qst610101_msg0103
rows.name:
I'll head over there later to
hear what you've found out.
